appShortcutName: Visual D - Visual Studio Integration of the D Programming Language
appDisplayName: Visual D - Visual Studio Integration of the D Programming Language
description:
Visual D is a Visual Studio package providing both project management and language services.


Changes since v1.5.0-rc2:
- dmdserver:
  - improve intellisense in __traits
  - define version VisualDServer to allow ensuring template instances
  - removed more stale pointers reducing memory requirements
  - updated to dmd 2.114-beta1
- fix reading ldc2.conf for LDC 1.42+ from subdirectories
- full installer now bundled with DMD 2.113.0 and LDC 1.43.0
